title: Fight Arena
start: Talk to Lady Servil, just north-west of the fight arena, which is south of Ardougne.

items.t: Armour, weapons and food (Ranged not recommended). Make sure you have enough food to survive in battle against the monsters below.
3 free inventory slots during the first stage of the quest (2 for your armour and 1 for the beer)

recommended.t: Any Ardougne cloak, for the Kandarin monastery Teleport.

kills.t: General Khazard twice (level 84 - this is an optional kill)

steps.t: Talk to Lady Servil west of the Monastery which is south of Ardougne. [Chat: Accept]
Head east and into the northeasternmost building (south of the monastery).
Borrow the Khazard armour from the northeasternmost suit of armour.
Equip the armour and enter the prison south of the building where you got the equipment (east of the big circle of the arena in the map).
Talk to the Lazy Khazard Guard sitting in the south-eastern corner of the jail.
Talk to Angor in the bar to the west, and buy a bottle of Khali brew for five coins. [Chat: 2 I'd like a Khali brew, please.]
Run back and talk to the Lazy Khazard Guard. Wait for him to pass out and then Steal keys from the table.
Use the keys on Sammy's cell door north of Lazy Khazard Guard.
Kill General Khazard or walk out the door.
Talk to Lady Servil at the quest start point northwest of the arena.
